# rwx_group_relationship (Resource)

Manages one direct parent/child group relationship. Children inherit their parents' permissions; parents do not inherit their children's permissions. A group can have multiple parents and children. Other relationships are preserved. Requires `org:access` to read and `group:manage` on the parent to add or remove the relationship. The server rejects cycles and removals that would leave the organization without an administrator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Choose either the direct-ID resource or the by-name resource for a given group pair.
resource "rwx_group_relationship" "engineering_deployers" {
  parent_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  child_group_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
}

data "rwx_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_group" "deployers" {
  name = "Deployers"
}

resource "rwx_group_relationship" "by_name" {
  parent_group_id = data.rwx_group.engineering.id
  child_group_id  = data.rwx_group.deployers.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `child_group_id` (String) The ID of the child group that inherits the parent's permissions. Changing this replaces the relationship.
- `parent_group_id` (String) The ID of the parent group whose permissions the child inherits. Changing this replaces the relationship.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The relationship identity, in parent-group-id/child-group-id format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_group_relationship.engineering_deployers 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
```
